title: Maximizing Families and Typical Periodic Optimization for Almost Additive Sequences
summary: In this paper, we study typical periodic optimization (TPO) for almost additive potentials in two perturbation spaces. Our main setting is the Banach quotient $\mathcal E_{\rm orb}(X,T)$ of orbit-Lipschitz almost additive potentials, where we extend the theory of maximizable sets and countable maximizable families developed by W. Huang, O. Jenkinson, L. Xu and Y. Zhang [Typical periodic optimization for dynamical systems: symbolic dynamics, Invent. Math. 245 (2026), 1--63], and establish a global structural theorem.
